verdict.rationale: Runtime probes confirm that bitwarden.com serves a live llms.txt (HTTP 200). They also show that help pages ship per-page markdown mirrors (e.g. /help/cli.md returns clean markdown), so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-friendly docs. Missing for 10: evidence of the llms.txt's coverage and depth beyond its header (e.g. no llms-full.txt or index of linked docs shown), and any first-party documentation or independent user reports describing agent use of these docs.
